editorial:
Imagine trying to use a magic spell to get your crush to love you, only for everything to go completely wrong. That is exactly what happens here! You get to follow Caber and Sasso, who decide to take a shortcut to romance by using magic. Instead of winning over the people they actually want, the spell glitches. Suddenly, Caber finds herself falling for Karim, a commercial director, and Sasso ends up obsessed with Bakha. It is a wild, funny ride that feels like a romantic comedy from a fever dream, keeping you guessing if these fake feelings will ever turn into the real thing.

The acting is light and fun, and the pacing moves quickly so you never get bored. While the plot is a bit silly, that is actually the best part. You might find some of the magic logic confusing, but just roll with it for the laughs. If you are in the mood for something breezy and cheerful, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, the magic spell finally wears off, forcing the characters to face their true feelings. They realize that the accidental love they felt under the spell actually grew into something real. Caber and Karim decide to stay together, and Sasso finds happiness with Bakha. The movie wraps up with a happy ending where they choose each other based on genuine connection rather than magic tricks, proving that true love cannot be forced.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly romantic comedies with a supernatural twist.
